## Forms · Get Context → `n8n_getContext(actor, workflowId)`
Returns `getWorkflowContext(workflowId)` — the full merged context the **email templates** use (request row + step results + action items), JSON-safe (dates → ISO) and with credentials **redacted** (passwords/temp passwords). Richer than *Get Workflow* (which is the checklist view). Unknown id → `EFX E_NOT_FOUND`.
Use it when a flow needs fields that are not on the `result` event (e.g. jobSiteNumber, systems, equipment, manager name, HR-verified title).

### Attribution
Pass `actor` from the calling workflow so Forms records who did it, e.g.
`{{ { id: 'n8n:' + $workflow.name, email: 'efx-bot@team-group.com', display: $workflow.name + ' (n8n)' } }}`
If omitted the Router attributes the call to itself. `idempotencyKey` (optional) makes a retry replay the first result for 10 min.
Errors throw as `EFX <CODE>: message` — attach an error output or error workflow on the calling node.
